dialog.entry.greet_first_angry.option.1: Could you have a better attitude?
dialog.entry.greet_close_friend.template: {tone}Great, {player_ref} is here! {self_ref} has been waiting for you.
dialog.entry.greet_close_friend.option.0: I'm glad to see you too
dialog.entry.greet_angry_known.template: ...{player_ref}. {self_ref} is in a bad mood right now. Leave me alone.
dialog.entry.greet_angry_known.option.1: All right, I'll come back later
dialog.entry.greet_danger.template: {tone}Careful! There are {enemy_count} enemies nearby! This is no place to stand around talking!
dialog.entry.greet_player_rich.template: {tone}Well, {player_ref}, you look pretty well off. {gold} gold...
dialog.entry.greet_player_poor.template: {tone}{player_ref}, you look a little short on coin... That's all right, have a look anyway.
dialog.entry.intro_ask.template: This place is remote, but it's peaceful enough. {filler}. What do you want to know?
dialog.entry.chat_casual.template: {tone}Not bad. {filler}. And you? Already on floor {floor}?
dialog.entry.chat_news.template: {tone}Lately... people say strange things have appeared in the deep levels. {filler}.
dialog.entry.chat_deep.template: {tone}Truth be told, {self_ref} doesn't think this place is simple. The caves below seem far deeper than we imagined. {filler}.
dialog.entry.chat_favor.template: {tone}You'd help? That's great. {filler}. Actually, {self_ref} has wanted to ask someone for a favor...
dialog.entry.chat_favor_detail.template: Next time you go into the caves, could you keep an eye out for anything unusual for {self_ref}? Anything at all.
dialog.entry.chat_secret.template: {tone}Since it's you, {player_ref}... {self_ref} will tell you something. Deep below, something ancient seems to be sleeping. {filler}.
dialog.entry.chat_secret_repeat.template: {tone}About that matter... have you gone to look yet? {filler}.
dialog.entry.chat_angry_reason.template: Don't ask... {filler}. Nothing has gone right lately.
dialog.entry.chat_angry_detail.template: I ran into trouble on the road. Lost quite a few things. ...Thanks for listening to {self_ref}.
dialog.entry.chat_danger_info.template: The caves below are full of monsters. The deeper you go, the more dangerous it gets. You're on floor {floor} now... go deeper and you'll meet stronger enemies. {filler}.
dialog.entry.chat_people_info.template: There are quite a few people in the village. Merchants come by now and then, and the blacksmith and herbalist are here too. If you need something, ask them. {filler}.
dialog.entry.chat_lore_deep.template: {tone}They say there's a ruin from an ancient age at the deepest level. No one knows what lies inside. {filler}.
dialog.entry.chat_after_favor.template: {tone}That favor I asked about last time... any news? {filler}.
dialog.entry.trade_intro.template: {tone}Take a look. It's all good stuff. {player_ref} has {gold} gold. {filler}.
dialog.entry.trade_friend_discount.templ: {tone}Since it's you, {player_ref}, {self_ref} will give you a discount. Friend price, as always.
dialog.entry.react_player_armored.templa: {tone}You're dressed pretty heavily. Heading into the deep levels? {filler}.
dialog.entry.react_legendary.template: {tone}So you're the legendary adventurer? {player_ref}, the one who killed {kill_count} monsters? {filler}!
dialog.entry.greet_shopkeeper_generic.te: {tone}Welcome! {self_ref} has everything you need here. Want to take a look, {player_ref}?
dialog.entry.greet_shopkeeper_happy.temp: {tone}Business is booming! You came at the right time, {player_ref}. {self_ref} just got a fresh batch of good stock!
dialog.entry.greet_wise_advice.template: {tone}You're already on floor {floor}... {filler}. Ask whatever you want to know.
dialog.entry.greet_wise_advice.option.0: What should I watch out for ahead?
dialog.entry.greet_wise_advice.option.1: Tell me about this place's history
dialog.entry.greet_timid_danger.template: {tone}I-I'm scared... there are {enemy_count} monsters nearby... can {player_ref} protect {self_ref}?
dialog.entry.greet_greedy_appraise.optio: Keep your mind off my money
dialog.entry.greet_remember_favor.templa: {tone}{player_ref}, {self_ref} still remembers what you did last time. {filler}.
dialog.entry.greet_remember_secret.templ: {tone}{player_ref}... about what we talked about last time, any progress?
dialog.entry.greet_remember_lore.templat: {tone}That ruin we talked about last time, {player_ref}... {self_ref} heard a little more about it. {filler}.
